item.title: Rescuers Drilled A Second Shaft To Reach Baby Jessica
item.description: Eighteen-month-old Jessica McClure fell 22 feet into a narrow well in Midland, Texas, in October 1987. Rescuers drilled a parallel shaft and connecting tunnel through rock, bringing her out alive after 58 hours as millions followed the rescue on television.

item.title: Their New Home Had A Coffin Lift In The Basement
item.description: The Snedeker family moved into a former funeral home in Southington, Connecticut, in 1986 and reported apparitions and unexplained disturbances. Their claims inspired The Haunting in Connecticut, but author Ray Garton later said parts of his account were fabricated

item.title: All These Powerful Political Figures Had a Close Relationship With Epstein
item.description: Released correspondence shows Jeffrey Epstein maintained relationships with Peter Mandelson and former Israeli prime minister Ehud Barak after his 2008 conviction. The records document continued political access, though association alone does not establish involvement in his crimes.

item.title: Cai Xukun Was Edited Out, But Viewers Spotted His Hands
item.description: Chinese singer Cai Xukun was digitally removed from a 2023 episode of Keep Running, but viewers spotted traces of him, including his hands. The edit followed allegations that he pressured a woman into an abortion. Cai acknowledged their past relationship but denied coercion or illegal conduct.

item.title: Prince Andrew Said He Cut Ties. His Emails Said Otherwise
item.description: Prince Andrew said he ended contact with Jeffrey Epstein in December 2010. Emails later revealed correspondence in 2011, contradicting that account. Andrew denies Virginia Giuffre’s sexual abuse allegations and settled her civil lawsuit in 2022 without admitting wrongdoing.
